title: v4 node.generate completion callback and result schema
description: Completion event and result payload delivered by a contract_version 4 node.generate plugin to the host callback endpoint. Inline callback bodies are capped at 64 KiB; larger outputs MUST be hosted on an HTTPS origin listed in the plugin manifest's base_url or data_handling.egress_domains and referenced via result_url (anti-SSRF enforced by the host). Idempotent by event_id with terminal-state freeze.

result_url.description: Optional top-level HTTPS URL for large results (> 64 KiB callback limit); host MUST match the plugin manifest's base_url or data_handling.egress_domains.

content_markdown.description: Generated Markdown body for the target node.

structured_output.description: Generated JSON object conforming to node_generate.output_contract.schema when format is 'json_schema'.

citations.description: Subset of ref_uri values from the context bundle provenance list.

usage_reported.description: Optional self-reported usage metadata (recorded by the host as executor_reported for display only, never used for host billing).

result_url.description: HTTPS URL hosting a JSON or Markdown result document on an allowlisted manifest egress domain.
